Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. We’re excited to kick off the POC with BrightMode. To get the POC moving, can we lock in a 90-minute kickoff + hands-on working session next week where we can:

- Introduce stakeholders and align on success criteria
- Walk through prompt designs and routing options
- Run a short load test (burst to 200 rps / 5-minute window) to validate throughput
- Confirm data/permissions and any compliance checks needed

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue, Mar 9 — 10:00–11:30 AM
- Wed, Mar 10 — 1:00–2:30 PM
- Thu, Mar 11 — 9:00–10:30 AM

Laura (SE) and Dev (infrastructure) will join to handle the prompt review and load testing. Ethan (CSM) will cover success criteria and post-POC acceptance steps.

If none of these work, happy to reschedule; please suggest a couple of times. I’ve attached a short kickoff agenda and a placeholder for the load test plan (we’ll finalize with Dev).

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Rajiv / Samantha —

Quick technical notes ahead of Wed:
- Load test plan attached (poc-load-test-plan.xlsx) — contains sample payloads, expected token sizes, and a simple k6 script snippet.
- For the hands-on prompt review, please share 3 representative prompts (1 control, 2 high-latency) so we can exercise routing and model selection rules.
- Routing note: if you expect long-context flows (>2k tokens), please flag them; we’ll select a variant optimized for long sequences.
- Rate limits: during the 5-minute burst, we’ll temporarily raise the limit for your test IPs. If you need to run additional longer tests, we’ll coordinate a dedicated window.

If you can drop the sample prompts into the shared drive before Tuesday EOD, I’ll prep the environment.

Dev

Marissa / team —

Confirmed: Wed Mar 10, 1:00–2:30 PM PST. I’ll attend and bring our integration lead (prelim: Kunal Singh) and one security engineer.

We uploaded three sample prompts to the Drive link and added a short doc with success criteria (accuracy thresholds, latency SLOs, and routing behavior). High level:
- Success criteria: >= 85% relevance on prompt set; median latency < 200ms for single-turn prompts; routing fallback behavior must route to secondary model within 300ms in case of overload.

Looking forward to the session. Please share the calendar invite and any remaining pre-reads.

Regards,
Rajiv
Head of Integrations | BrightMode Analytics
